c-mod-contents-check.desc: Checks the root `mod.rs` of every `c/` directory (a `mod.rs` whose parent folder is named `c`) declares all of its modules as public (`pub mod ...`) and contains no `use` statements.

exception.desc: If the `c/` directory contains a nested `c/` sub-directory, the root `mod.rs` must instead:

items.item: Declare the nested module privately as `mod c;`, annotated with the outer attribute `#[allow(clippy::module_inception)]`
Have a single `pub use c::*;` glob statement re-exporting the nested `c` module.
